result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now dispatches to the same landscape code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles, but I didn't run any tests or try either command, so none of this has been exercised.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both names to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. In that method, `-help` prints the usage for whichever name the user typed, with its own description. `updateLandscape -help` prints what it did before.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` and `updateConfig`.
- **`CLAUDE.md`**: I also added `analyzeLandscape` to its command list, which you didn't ask for.
